internshipPrograms.title: Web Development Internship Track
internshipPrograms.description: Comprehensive engineering program focused on semantic HTML5, modern vanilla CSS, responsive architecture, client-side JavaScript, and performance-tuned web interfaces.
internshipPrograms.skills: Semantic HTML, Modern CSS Grid & Flexbox, JavaScript ES6+, Core Web Vitals, Responsive Layouts, Accessibility (a11y)
internshipPrograms.learningOutcomes: Build production-ready responsive web interfaces, optimize Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) and Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS), and integrate client-side logic with REST APIs.
internshipPrograms.eligibility: Students or graduates enrolled in Computer Science, BCA, B.Tech, or related technology tracks with foundational knowledge of web development.
internshipPrograms.requirements: Personal laptop or computer, modern web browser, code editor (VS Code or similar), and consistent weekly commitment of 10-12 hours.

internshipPrograms.title: Software & Full-Stack Development Track
internshipPrograms.description: Practical full-stack engineering track focusing on Node.js backend architecture, relational database management, authentication flows, RESTful APIs, and edge deployment.
internshipPrograms.skills: Node.js, Express/HTTP, SQLite/PostgreSQL, Authentication & Sessions, REST API Design, Git Version Control
internshipPrograms.learningOutcomes: Design and build secure backend services, implement session management and password hashing, manage relational database schemas, and deploy resilient cloud services.
internshipPrograms.eligibility: Students with basic programming knowledge in JavaScript or Python seeking backend and full-stack software development experience.
internshipPrograms.requirements: Computer system with Node.js LTS installed, Git, basic terminal familiarity, and weekly commitment of 12-14 hours.

internshipPrograms.title: UI/UX Design & Product Interface Track
internshipPrograms.description: Design systems, wireframing, high-fidelity interactive prototyping, usability testing, and accessible design principles modeled on modern digital product standards.
internshipPrograms.skills: Figma Prototyping, Design Systems, Typography & Color Tokens, Wireframing, User Journey Mapping, WCAG 2.1 Accessibility
internshipPrograms.learningOutcomes: Create complete design system tokens, assemble interactive Figma clickable prototypes, conduct structured user testing, and deliver developer-ready UI specs.
internshipPrograms.eligibility: Designers, aspiring product designers, and creative students with keen attention to visual aesthetics and usability.
internshipPrograms.requirements: Free Figma account, computer capable of web-based design tooling, and 8-10 hours weekly commitment.

internshipPrograms.title: AI & Applied Machine Learning Track
internshipPrograms.description: Practical curriculum exploring data preprocessing, supervised learning models, evaluation metrics, and API integration with cutting-edge machine learning pipelines.
internshipPrograms.skills: Python, NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-Learn, Feature Engineering, RESTful ML Inference, Model Validation
internshipPrograms.learningOutcomes: Clean and preprocess real-world tabular datasets, train classification and regression models, measure accuracy/F1/ROC metrics, and serve models via API.
internshipPrograms.eligibility: Students with basic Python programming and linear algebra/statistics foundational understanding.
internshipPrograms.requirements: Python 3.10+ environment, Jupyter Notebooks or Google Colab, and 10-12 hours weekly commitment.

internshipPrograms.title: Cloud Architecture & DevOps Track
internshipPrograms.description: Infrastructure essentials covering serverless functions, Cloudflare Workers & Pages, edge caching, CI/CD validation pipelines, and system reliability monitoring.
internshipPrograms.skills: Cloudflare Pages/Workers, Edge Routing, Git Automation, SSL/TLS Hardening, DNS Configuration, Performance Monitoring
internshipPrograms.learningOutcomes: Configure zero-downtime static and edge application deployments, implement automated branch validation, and enforce strict HTTP security headers.
internshipPrograms.eligibility: Students interested in cloud computing, DevOps pipelines, and modern serverless platforms.
internshipPrograms.requirements: Terminal access, GitHub account, and 8-10 hours weekly commitment.
